title: Patient and PII storage compliance policy lookup
query_text: Can I store data containing patient or personally identifiable information (PII) on /lustre/scratch? Where must I store it under the cluster's data management policy, and what happens if I violate that policy? Please cite the relevant policy section.
difficulty_justification: A single documentation retrieval exposes the Compliance clause covering the storage restriction, required filesystem designation, and consequence of a violation.

eval_criteria.gold_answer: No; the snapshot does not identify /lustre/scratch as a tier4_sensitive designated filesystem. Section 5, Compliance, of docs/data_management_policy.md requires patient or personally identifiable information (PII) to reside only on filesystems with that designation. The snapshot does not name a concrete permitted storage path. A violation triggers immediate account suspension.
